rationale.validation: Incorrectly attributes named-variable restriction to allow_variables; actual frozen handler ignores it. Depth limitation is disclosed correctly and most returned syntax verdicts are interpreted correctly.
rationale.guidance: Usable AST allowlist/no-eval guidance, input-size/node/depth guards, failclosed handling, rate limit and leastprivilege recommendations.
rationale.implementation_consistency: Code and prose overclaim bounded computation on untrusted numeric variables. No magnitude/bit bound on accepted integer variables or operation results; optional exponent guard alone also lacks base/result bound. Syntax parses, but this does not establish the declared resource-exhaustion protection.

reviewer: Same coordinator, not independent human or strictly methodblind; frozen propertyrubric; staticinspection only.
